sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be 
performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

Fuel oil pumps
guarantee oil delivery to the burners for firing through two 
lines one to unit 5, and the other to the unit 6, each line has two fuel oil 
pumps and two heaters.
المواصفات الفنية:
Flow rate for Mazout pump = 120 m3/h
Temperature = 120 OC
Pump pressure delivery = 42 bar
